SYN01_text2sql_chess_8a3b080c.query_text: Show me 5000 cases of students taking classes taught by professors from their own department.
SYN01_text2sql_chess_8a3b080c.final_sql: SELECT student_name, class_name, professor_name FROM (   SELECT US.name AS student_name,          UC.name AS class_name,          F.name AS professor_name   FROM undergraduateStudentTakeCourse AS T1   INNER JOIN undergraduateStudent AS US     ON T1.undergraduateStudentID = US.nr   INNER JOIN undergraduateCourse AS UC     ON T1.undergraduateCourseID = UC.nr   INNER JOIN professor AS P     ON UC.teacher = P.nr   INNER JOIN faculty AS F     ON P.nr = F.nr   WHERE US.memberOf = F.worksFor    UNION ALL    SELECT GS.name AS student_name,          GC.name AS class_name,          F.name AS professor_name   FROM graduateStudentTakeCourse AS T2   INNER JOIN graduateStudent AS GS     ON T2.graduateStudentID = GS.nr   INNER JOIN graduateCourse AS GC     ON T2.graduateCourseID = GC.nr   INNER JOIN professor AS P     ON GC.teacher = P.nr   INNER JOIN faculty AS F     ON P.nr = F.nr   WHERE GS.memberOf = F.worksFor ) LIMIT 5000

SYN04_text2sql_chess_07db30cc.query_text: Show me 1000 cases of which transit routes pass through which platforms.
SYN04_text2sql_chess_07db30cc.final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT R.route_long_name, S.stop_name FROM ROUTES AS R INNER JOIN TRIPS AS T ON R.route_id = T.route_id INNER JOIN STOP_TIMES AS ST ON T.trip_id = ST.trip_id INNER JOIN STOPS AS S ON ST.stop_id = S.stop_id WHERE S.location_type = 0 LIMIT 1000

SYN05_text2sql_chess_f5d6c27b.query_text: Per department, how many people are registered for classes, and which ones?
SYN05_text2sql_chess_f5d6c27b.final_sql: WITH registered_people AS (   SELECT DISTINCT U.memberOf AS dept_id, 'UG' AS person_type, U.nr AS person_id, U.name AS person_name   FROM undergraduateStudentTakeCourse AS T   INNER JOIN undergraduateStudent AS U     ON T.undergraduateStudentID = U.nr   UNION ALL   SELECT DISTINCT G.memberOf AS dept_id, 'GR' AS person_type, G.nr AS person_id, G.name AS person_name   FROM graduateStudentTakeCourse AS T   INNER JOIN graduateStudent AS G     ON T.graduateStudentID = G.nr ) SELECT D.name, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY D.nr) AS registered_people_count, R.person_name FROM registered_people AS R INNER JOIN department AS D   ON R.dept_id = D.nr ORDER BY D.name, R.person_name

SYN06_text2sql_chess_6d82bc66.query_text: For each transit route, how many times does it halt altogether and what is the mean per trip?
SYN06_text2sql_chess_6d82bc66.final_sql: SELECT R.route_long_name, COUNT(S.stop_id) AS total_halts, CAST(COUNT(S.stop_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T.trip_id) AS mean_per_trip FROM ROUTES AS R INNER JOIN TRIPS AS T ON R.route_id = T.route_id INNER JOIN STOP_TIMES AS S ON T.trip_id = S.trip_id GROUP BY R.route_id, R.route_long_name

SYN08_text2sql_chess_71a08c84.query_text: Which 10 places in the transit network are served by the most trips?
SYN08_text2sql_chess_71a08c84.final_sql: SELECT T1.stop_name FROM STOPS AS T1 INNER JOIN STOP_TIMES AS T2 ON T1.stop_id = T2.stop_id GROUP BY T1.stop_name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.trip_id) DESC, T1.stop_name ASC LIMIT 10
SYN08_text2sql_chess_71a08c84.gt_sparql:
PREFIX tro: <http://example.org/ontology/transport#>
PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/>
SELECT ?stop ?stopName (COUNT(?trip) AS ?tripCount) WHERE {
    ?stopTime a tro:StopEvent .
    ?stop a tro:Stop .
    ?trip a tro:Trip .
    ?stopTime tro:station ?stop .
    ?stopTime tro:journey ?trip .
    OPTIONAL { ?stop foaf:name ?stopName }
}
GROUP BY ?stop ?stopName
ORDER BY DESC(?tripCount)
LIMIT 10

SYN09_text2sql_chess_f2203faa.query_text: Which faculty teaching upper-level classes have nobody under their supervision?
SYN09_text2sql_chess_f2203faa.final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT f.name FROM faculty AS f INNER JOIN graduateCourse AS g ON f.nr = g.teacher LEFT JOIN graduateStudent AS gs ON f.nr = gs.advisor LEFT JOIN undergraduateStudent AS us ON f.nr = us.advisor WHERE gs.advisor IS NULL   AND us.advisor IS NULL

SYN10_text2sql_chess_9b049893.query_text: Which items are the least expensive and the costliest?
SYN10_text2sql_chess_9b049893.final_sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.item_name FROM merchandise AS m INNER JOIN price_listings AS p ON m.item_id = p.item_id WHERE p.unit_price = (     SELECT MIN(p2.unit_price)     FROM merchandise AS m2     INNER JOIN price_listings AS p2 ON m2.item_id = p2.item_id ) OR p.unit_price = (     SELECT MAX(p3.unit_price)     FROM merchandise AS m3     INNER JOIN price_listings AS p3 ON m3.item_id = p3.item_id )

SYN11_text2sql_chess_c381600f.query_text: Where has more than 50000000 in oil been pumped out altogether?
SYN11_text2sql_chess_c381600f.final_sql: SELECT field_name FROM annual_output GROUP BY field_name HAVING SUM(oil_output_msm3) > 50

SYN12_text2sql_chess_9f341746.query_text: Show every undergraduate and graduate class alongside who teaches it and which department it falls under.
SYN12_text2sql_chess_9f341746.final_sql: SELECT U.name, F.name, D.name FROM undergraduateCourse AS U INNER JOIN faculty AS F ON U.teacher = F.nr INNER JOIN department AS D ON F.worksFor = D.nr UNION ALL SELECT G.name, F.name, D.name FROM graduateCourse AS G INNER JOIN faculty AS F ON G.teacher = F.nr INNER JOIN department AS D ON F.worksFor = D.nr

SYN14_text2sql_chess_e857fae2.final_sql: SELECT T4.name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.nr = T2.subOrganizationOf INNER JOIN faculty AS T3 ON T2.nr = T3.worksFor INNER JOIN undergraduateCourse AS T4 ON T3.nr = T4.teacher WHERE T1.name = 'university0' UNION SELECT T4.name FROM university AS T1 INNER JOIN department AS T2 ON T1.nr = T2.subOrganizationOf INNER JOIN faculty AS T3 ON T2.nr = T3.worksFor INNER JOIN graduateCourse AS T4 ON T3.nr = T4.teacher WHERE T1.name = 'university0'
